snippet.title: The Quest for the BIG KEY (official Trailer)
snippet.description:
Get it on Steam:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/777820/The_Quest_for_the_BIG_KEY/

The Quest for the BIG KEY is highly inspired by NES classics that you will no doubt recognize. It focuses more on the exploring part. 

It comes completely without Enemies and Battles. So if you like finding secret passages and collecting items that allow you to progress in different parts of the map, this game is for you.

Just don't die!
